title: Remarks on invertible phases with non-onsite symmetry
summary: We study invertible phases protected by non-onsite symmetries carrying nontrivial lattice anomaly indices. While lattice anomalies are usually viewed as obstructions to symmetric short-range-entangled (SRE) states, we show that anomalous lattice symmetries can nevertheless admit invertible phases that are not SRE, and can moreover shift the set of symmetry-compatible invertible phases. In particular, we consider a fermionic $\mathbb Z_4^F$ symmetry in (2+1) dimensions.
